title: Large Vintage Le Creuset baking dish 36 – White Enamel Made in France
description:
Beautiful large vintage oval baking dish by Le Creuset in elegant white enamel. A timeless French kitchen piece, perfect for gratins, roasted vegetables, lasagna, family meals, or stylish table serving.
This large size 36 model measures approximately 40 cm long with handles and around 30 cm wide. Its generous depth makes it ideal for oven cooking and serving directly at the table. The classic white finish gives it a clean and refined vintage look that fits beautifully in both modern and rustic kitchens.
Marked “Made in France – Le Creuset” on the underside. The dish is in very good vintage condition with light signs of use consistent with age. Please check all photos carefully as they are part of the description.
A beautiful and increasingly difficult-to-find vintage Le Creuset baking dish in this large size and classic color.
